tags.description: Lots of Green Sunfish that get to be up to a pound or so. Also some Bluegill. Would recommend a jig on a long pole.
tags.name: Rutherford lot pond

tags.note: This feature is new or replaced following the Dec 2023 Tornado. Though no dates provided for ESRI World Imagery (Clarity) Beta and Mapbox imagery, the features do match Google Maps imagery dated in 2025.
